    Milky Way Astrophysics & Navigation

    SBbc Barred Spiral Architecture

    This real-time WebGL2 HDR simulation models up to 5 million stars across five distinct galactic populations: a triaxial boxy/peanut bulge and 27° galactic bar, four logarithmic spiral arms plus the Orion-Cygnus Spur housing Sol at R = 8.178 kpc, an exponential flaring thin disk, an older thick disk, and a spheroidal halo studded with globular clusters.

    Ray-Marched Interstellar Dust & Spectroscopy

    Each star integrates line-of-sight optical depth through a co-rotating 1024×1024 midplane dust map. In Optical mode, light passing behind the Great Rift undergoes wavelength-dependent extinction and reddening; switching to Near-IR (JWST) pierces the dust lanes to expose the hidden inner bar, while Ultraviolet isolates hot O/B stellar nurseries.
